329:t_1:86.en:
$$宗介$$
(But at least $$レモン$$ isn't an enemy. That makes the situation in $$ナムサク$$ my immediate concern...)

329:t_1:87.en:
$$宗介$$
(But why does $$レモン$$ want to save $$ナミ$$...? Does he like her... or is there something special...?)

329:t_1:90.en:
$$宗介$$
(Despite having no engineering knowledge, $$ナミ$$ modified an AS and created its fire-control software herself...)

329:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(Could she also be... a 《$$ウィスパード$$》...?)

329:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, that coincidence is impossible. The odds of encountering something less than one in several million here...)

329:t_1:96.en:
$$宗介$$
「They're shooting in a place like this?!」

329:t_1:98.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Just kidding! That was only a warning shot!」

329:t_1:99.en:
$$宗介$$
「That voice...! You're from $$アマルガム$$...!」

329:t_1:101.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「So, let me introduce myself! I'm $$ゲイツ$$, $$ファイヤバグ$$'s handsome boy of the century... no, handsome middle-aged gentleman!」

329:t_1:102.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アマルガム$$ hired you to hunt me down!」

329:t_1:103.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That's right. Lucky old $$ゲイツ$$ looks set to finish two jobs at once here in $$ナムサク$$!」

329:t_1:104.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I'm eliminating $$ミスリル$$'s survivors, aaand purging the naughty people!」

329:t_1:105.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll kill you right here instead!」

329:t_1:106.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Not so fast, you whatchamacallit! $$クラマ$$ says he's going to deal with you!」

329:t_1:107.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's here in $$ナムサク$$ too?!」

329:t_1:108.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Sweet, sweet $$ナミ$$ is probably in $$クラマ$$'s hands by now.」

329:t_1:110.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahahahaha! That's the face I wanted to see!」

329:t_1:111.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I've got a message from $$クラマ$$. He's waiting for you at the arena with $$ナミ$$!」

329:t_1:114.en:
$$宗介$$
(What do I do...? Now that $$アマルガム$$ has moved, following that man with the sideburns should yield some information.)

329:t_1:115.en:
$$宗介$$
(But if I do that, $$ナミ$$ will...)

329:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(The enemy is $$クラマ$$ and his men... Ten in all...)

329:t_2:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I rush out carelessly, they'll kill me instantly. I can't move now...)

329:t_2:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「We won't get anywhere playing hide-and-seek here...」

329:t_2:9.en:
$$クラマ$$
「$$相良$$, are you watching?! I know you're here! Come out and drop your weapons!」

329:t_2:10.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Or I'll kill the girl! I'll give you ten seconds!」

329:t_2:13.en:
$$宗介$$
(That man is a professional. He always follows through on what he says in a negotiation.)

329:t_2:14.en:
$$宗介$$
(And I know from what happened at $$陣代高校$$ that he is ruthless.)

329:t_2:15.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't fight that many enemies alone. And if I accept $$クラマ$$'s terms and come out, he'll shoot me without a word.)

329:t_2:16.en:
$$宗介$$
(I've survived so many hellish situations, and now I'm suddenly cornered in a place like this...)

329:t_2:17.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't die here... I have to save $$千鳥$$ and make $$レナード$$ and $$アマルガム$$ pay...)

329:t_2:20.en:
$$宗介$$
(But there's no reason to let $$ナミ$$ die. She has nothing to do with $$ミスリル$$ or $$アマルガム$$. I can't let her die here...!)

329:t_2:21.en:
$$宗介$$
(A choice that will keep both me and $$ナミ$$ alive...)

329:t_2:22.en:
$$宗介$$
(There must be one... There has to be... Think... Think...)

329:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
(...There isn't one. There's no choice that convenient.)

329:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
(What if $$クラマ$$'s countdown is a bluff...? If I just keep hiding...)

329:t_2:26.en:
$$宗介$$
(No, now that he has declared he'll shoot $$ナミ$$...)

329:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I have no choice but to come out!)

329:t_2:29.en:
$$宗介$$
(That will buy a little more than two seconds. Surely a chance to turn things around will come in that time...)

329:t_2:30.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...No, I've changed my mind. The countdown ends here.」

329:t_2:32.en:
$$クラマ$$
「If you want someone to blame, blame $$相良$$.」

329:t_2:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「Run, $$ナミ$$! You can escape now!」

329:t_2:43.en:
$n
「I'm sorry, $$宗介$$! I'm a little late!!」

329:t_2:45.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$クラマ$$! Taking a girl hostage and ignoring your own countdown... That's just like you!」

329:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クルツ$$! Then that sniper shot was...!」

329:t_2:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Of course it was me! Who else could pull off a miraculous shot like that?!」

329:t_2:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Leave the rest to me, $$宗介$$.」

329:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「But why are you all here...?」

329:t_2:51.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We got information from $$ミシェル・レモン$$.」
